$comment: The C type of every constant the shipped <windows.h> declares, each stated by a _Static_assert over _Generic, so a wrong type in the shipped header fails the COMPILE on every host. The table was MEASURED 2026-10-10 on both pe references (MSVC cl 19.51 x64 and MinGW-w64 gcc 13.2.0 printed the identical 117 lines: 63 int, 22 long, 31 unsigned long, 1 unsigned int), and this same file compiles and answers 42 under both. Before this example the shipped header typed 100 of the 117 as unsigned int: 69 of them are signed under the references (47 int, 22 long), which changes the ANSWER of a comparison or a subtraction with a negative operand (`-1 < MEM_COMMIT` was false), and 31 are unsigned long, which changes what _Generic and a pointer to the constant's type see. At run time the program makes the comparisons whose answer depends on the type, each with an operand read from a volatile object so the comparison is made by emitted code and not by the folder: exit 1..4 names the first to fail, 42 = all right. The release arm is the same file through the optimizer.
